title: 'Sound, light and frequency' turns up in a CERN God-particle white paper

tellings.quote: that I got a hit on that exact phrase in that order was in 2012, about 15 years, in a white paper for the discovery of the God particle.

plain: The phrase "sound, light and frequency" turned up word for word in a 2012 white paper from CERN, the European physics laboratory, about turning the data from the discovery of the so-called God particle into sound, says the screenwriter Brent Friedman. Friedman says he had used the phrase himself and searched for it, and that this was the first hit he got, about fifteen years later. He tells it as a strange echo between his own work and frontier physics.
